summary: The reproduced formatting and parsing failures all point to a fourfold mismatch in the subsecond conversion at the Abseil/CCTZ boundary. The current excerpts show the conversion sites, but the duration representation contract and full parse assertions are missing, so the concrete repair is not yet fully grounded.
hypotheses: `Split()` scales Abseil's low duration part incorrectly when converting it to CCTZ femtoseconds, causing the formatting errors.
`Join()` scales parsed CCTZ femtoseconds incorrectly when constructing an Abseil duration, causing the parse errors.
A changed duration representation contract explains both conversion failures.
